brand.name: Mi Querida
brand.description: Steve Saka's second release under Dunbarton Tobacco & Trust (founded after Saka left Drew Estate in 2013/2015). 'Mi Querida' ('my dearest'/colloquially 'my mistress' in Nicaragua) is a deliberately gritty, old-school-style Nicaraguan puro built around Connecticut Broadleaf, contrasting with Dunbarton's more refined Sobremesa line. IMPORTANT: physically stored next to Aganorsa Leaf on the Mac, but this is its OWN brand (Dunbarton Tobacco & Trust), not an Aganorsa Leaf product line - should be modeled as a separate brand entry in the database, not nested under Aganorsa Leaf.
brand.founded: 2016 (announced June 2016, retail debut July 2016); Dunbarton Tobacco & Trust founded 2013/2015
brand.notes: Factory documented as NACSA (Nicaragua American Cigars S.A.), Estelí, overseen by Master Cigarmaker Raul Disla - not independently confirmed as an Aganorsa-owned facility in sources checked, despite the Mac's folder placement suggesting a connection.

vitolas.name: Gordo
vitolas.notes: Could not confirm an official vitola literally named just 'Gordo' - the line's stout vitola is officially 'Muy Gordo Grande' (6x56, since discontinued/replaced by a 6x64 size) and a separate 'Gorila Gordo' (6x60) also exists. Flagging as unresolved pending photo/box inspection rather than guessing which one this Mac photo shows.

vitolas.name: Triqui Traca No. 764
vitolas.notes: Correct spelling is 'Triqui Traca' (not the Mac filename's 'Triqui-Traqui'). Technically a distinct sub-line within Mi Querida (adds Dominican ligero to the Nicaraguan filler, medium strength, introduced 2019/2020) rather than identical to the core Mi Querida blend.
